intro: Novice Elreth is an undead member of the Forsaken stationed inside the chapel at Deathknell. As newly risen undead awaken into their second life, she directs them to confront the mindless Scourge haunting the nearby graves and tend to the tragic aftermath of the plague.

sections.t: A Guide in the Church of the Damned
p: Inside the desecrated chapel at Deathknell, Novice Elreth assists the emerging undead as they struggle to understand their horrific awakening. Rather than succumbing to despair or the mindless hunger of the Scourge, the Forsaken must organize quickly to secure their territory. Elreth provides newly freed souls with early tasks, directing them to gather paws and wings from the wolves and bats to the south and deal with the lingering remnants of Lordaeron's tragic downfall, including the sorrow of her friend Marla Fipps, slain by her own husband Samuel after he joined the mindless Scourge.
